signature: SUBROUTINE DLAED6( KNITER, ORGATI, RHO, D, Z, FINIT, TAU, INFO )

params.name: kniter
params.reference: Refer to DLAED4 for its significance.

params.name: orgati
params.reference: If `ORGATI` is true, the needed root is between d(2) and d(3); otherwise it is between d(1) and d(2). See DLAED4 for further details.

params.name: rho
params.reference: Refer to the equation f(x) above.

params.name: z
params.reference: Each of the elements in z must be positive.

params.name: finit
params.reference: The value of f at 0. It is more accurate than the one evaluated inside this routine (if someone wants to do so).

params.name: tau
params.reference: The root of the equation f(x).

params.name: info
params.reference:
-   `= 0`: successful exit
-   `> 0`: if `INFO = 1`, failure to converge
